meta.schema_version_notes: ground-v2 reference output anchored to the 2036 deployed-year space-model cohort over its service life; ground assumptions are source-status tagged through the research wiki source ledger. A 'uses' entry prefixed 'space:' resolves in the space artifact at anchor.space_model_path; every other entry resolves in this artifact. Since ground-v1 the cost fields over the comparison period are named *_service_life* (they were *_five_year*), the duplicate orbital_reference.five_year_cost_view is gone (read orbital_reference.total_build_and_launch_cost), and the data dictionary's source_class is lowercase.
